claims.statement: Retained: for a finite rooted forest, attaching a pendant path at the root gives I(G_m)=I(G-r)P_m+zI(G-N[r])P_(m-1), and this identity computes the strict fixed-rank selector test separately for each surviving original leaf tag and for the new endpoint.
claims.scope: The exact selector propagation identity under pendant-path attachment, with zero-extended coefficients at every integer rank. It does not assert preservation of primary eligibility or any conclusion about the complete selected aggregate.
claims.reason: retained — root-absent and root-present independent sets give disjoint exhaustive terms I(G-r)P_m and zI(G-N[r])P_(m-1). Applying the identity to each T-v proves the strict selector test per old leaf tag; deleting the new endpoint gives T_(m-1). The K1,7 calculation is correct but fails x+2<=p, so it establishes only selector non-preservation outside primary eligibility.

limitations: No preservation of x(T), alpha(T), or the primary lower-region eligibility guards is proved.
No bound or sign comparison for the complete selected sum S is established.
The strict sign-change example lies outside primary eligibility and does not refute the primary aggregate.
